title: Agent Q v2 implementation milestones
format_note: Repository planning format; not an AQ daemon import schema. No live tasks or issues are created by this file.
dependency_semantics: depends_on contains hard prerequisites. Milestones group acceptance, not automatic start barriers. Ready means planned with all explicit dependencies complete; it is not permission to deploy or publish.
definition_of_done: Implementation and tests reviewed in the owning repository against an immutable source revision.
Acceptance evidence records exact commands, environment, artifact identity and remaining limits.
Consume public interfaces only; no sibling private state or mandatory sibling source checkout.
Update requirement evidence and dependent product pins when applicable. A passing component suite does not close a product gate.

milestones.title: Implementation audit and executable task plan
milestones.outcome: Evidence-labelled baseline and validated dependency graph.

milestones.title: Execution contract and independently packaged connector
milestones.outcome: Compatible foundation connector extracted and consumed as a pinned artifact; execution contract shared by both sides.

milestones.title: Minimal distributed fake-agent execution
milestones.outcome: One daemon and worker complete a durable synthetic assignment without duplicate launch.

milestones.title: Recovery and cancellation proof
milestones.outcome: Ambiguous launch, restart, lease expiry, cancellation and late results remain safe and explicit.

milestones.title: Real agent context, source handoff and graph outcome
milestones.outcome: One supported harness reads scoped graph context, edits a supported repository, hands source off and records a version-checked outcome.

milestones.title: Policy-driven coding and operational workflows
milestones.outcome: Embedded playbooks invoke real AQ adapters for coding/review/check, routing, watcher and reporting pilot flows.

milestones.title: Usable, measured and upgradeable product candidate
milestones.outcome: Dashboard, exact-artifact assembly, upgrades, target-host recovery and a declared capacity envelope pass product acceptance.

tasks.title: Record implementation audit and validate the task graph
tasks.scope: Inspect local source, test definitions and existing evidence; identify missing product behavior and hard dependencies.
acceptance: Audit distinguishes implemented, recorded validation, partial, design-only and externally unverified behavior.
Snapshot and graph are retained; all links, IDs, dependency edges, reachability and acyclicity validate.

tasks.title: Qualify the existing foundation baseline
tasks.scope: Select the current foundation revision and run its applicable Rust, PostgreSQL, connector and update-lifecycle checks; reconcile existing Phase 1 work before extraction.
acceptance: Record exact revision, commands, outcomes and image identities; distinguish local evidence from hosted qualification.
Retain compatibility fixtures for enrollment, heartbeat, probe, credential revocation, persisted identity and update state formats.
out_of_scope: Provisioning or changing a live deployment

tasks.title: Publish the execution contract and conformance fixtures
tasks.scope: Specify and implement wire schemas/types, explicit capability/version negotiation, replay identities, bounded exchanges, fake coordinator/worker fixtures and both-side review.
acceptance: Fixtures cover changed-payload conflicts, grant/reservation expiry, observation sequencing, cancellation, retained-result reporting and reconciliation.
Schema/type drift checks run standalone; foundation v1 meanings remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Extract the foundation connector into aq-worker
tasks.scope: Move compatible connector behavior into a standalone Rust workspace with published wire dependencies, configuration/identity continuity, independent CI and an immutable integration image.
acceptance: Enrollment, reconnect, heartbeat and revocation tests run without the agent-q source checkout.
Reusing an existing node configuration preserves identity; candidate artifact records exact source and dependency versions.

tasks.title: Consume the standalone connector and remove duplicate ownership
tasks.scope: Update development, smoke and release wiring to use the pinned worker candidate and shared public wire contract; retire the duplicate production connector source after compatibility passes.
acceptance: Existing enroll/heartbeat/restart/revoke smoke passes with the standalone artifact.
Normal AQ builds no longer require an in-tree worker implementation or sibling source path.

tasks.title: Add reproducible integration assembly and explicit local overrides
tasks.scope: Provide a small product fixture selecting exact server/worker artifacts and contract versions, with reusable slots for later graph/Git/playbook dependencies.
acceptance: One documented command assembles an isolated fixture without changing developer or production state.
Official candidate inputs reject floating references/local overrides; explicit development overrides identify their source.

tasks.title: Accept contract and connector compatibility
tasks.scope: Run both-side contract checks and the existing foundation lifecycle using the pinned standalone worker.
acceptance: Exact-artifact enrollment, reconnect and revocation pass; unsupported execution is declined while allowed foundation connectivity remains visible.
Publish the tested contract/candidate references for downstream tasks.

tasks.title: Qualify an immutable graph integration candidate
tasks.scope: Reuse the existing service; select an exact candidate, reproduce current contract/storage checks, and document receipt, principal, API and schema compatibility for AQ.
acceptance: Retain current tests and an isolated backup/restore result for the selected artifact; do not substitute old benchmark evidence.
Consumer contract documents version conflicts, identical-key replay, credential lifecycle and receipt retention; versioned image is reproducible.

tasks.title: Qualify and package an immutable Git integration candidate
tasks.scope: Preserve the current implementation, select a committed candidate, verify correctness/process handoff and package a checksummed executable with honest profile/compatibility limits.
acceptance: Run the retained-source worker-loss scenario and current required correctness checks against the candidate.
Manifest ties binary to build/source; unsupported repository features are explicit and rejected; remaining performance, host-power-loss and hosted-transport gates remain named.
out_of_scope: Claiming local process tests certify host power loss

tasks.title: Qualify the existing playbook implementation as a library candidate
tasks.scope: Reconcile concurrent implementation work, select the revision beyond the design-only commit, qualify library/CLI artifacts and current core/PostgreSQL/pilot evidence, and publish the Host/storage contract.
acceptance: Database-free tests and explicitly enabled isolated PostgreSQL tests pass on the selected candidate.

Limits and evidence for synchronous storage, snapshot/index/retention behavior, exact pins, join typing, optional protection and host-only functionality are included in compatibility metadata; the old test report does not certify new code.
out_of_scope: Claiming fake-host pilots are AQ integration

tasks.title: Persist execution authority and immutable attempt inputs
tasks.scope: Add migrations and transactional transitions for attempts, sessions, node incarnations, offers, generations, grants and resolved specification digests.
acceptance: Concurrent claims/acceptances cannot grant conflicting authority; duplicate IDs with different bytes fail.
Restart preserves authority and deadlines; state-format/recovery rules are updated with the migration.

tasks.title: Implement worker exchanges and durable result dispositions
tasks.scope: Implement incarnation registration, bounded poll/accept/decline, renewal, sequenced progress and immutable report admission with fake-worker tests.
acceptance: Lost acceptance/report acknowledgements return original committed dispositions without duplicate launches or outcomes.
Stale boot/generation and expired local reservation reports cannot settle a current attempt.

tasks.title: Implement local journal, capacity reservation and grant admission
tasks.scope: Add versioned durable records, exclusive runtime ownership, bounded node-wide resource reservations and acceptance/grant validation using the fake coordinator.
acceptance: Crash/replay and racing offers cannot over-allocate capacity; durable state survives full-disk/write-failure injection.
Late grants cannot resurrect expired reservations; no project-by-slot preallocation is introduced.

tasks.title: Launch and report one deterministic fake agent
tasks.scope: Implement a deterministic harness/execution adapter and journaled launch identity, phase observations, writer-stop proof and report retry.
acceptance: Fixture process completes through collecting/reporting/acknowledgement with one session per attempt.
Launch-window uncertainty never causes blind relaunch; confirmed stopped writers are required before resource reuse.

tasks.title: Add test-only deterministic assignment scheduling
tasks.scope: Drive the initial execution fixture from explicitly preapproved synthetic task/context inputs and deterministic compatible-node selection.
acceptance: Fixture assignments use production authority transitions and worker local admission.
Synthetic task provider is excluded from production configuration and cannot imply graph completion.

tasks.title: Demonstrate minimal distributed execution
tasks.scope: Extend the product fixture to run the deterministic fake agent through actual daemon/worker transport and persisted state.
acceptance: One assignment completes; repeated polls, lost acceptance response and lost report acknowledgement do not create duplicate execution.
Retain an executable demonstration with exact images, logs and correlation IDs; no model provider is required.

tasks.title: Implement cancellation, reconciliation and bounded retry policy
tasks.scope: Serialize cancellation/result eligibility, persist directives and retry lineage/budgets, reconcile old boots/grants and keep uncertain attempts visible.
acceptance: Cancellation/completion races and late superseded reports have stable outcomes; expiry never proves physical termination.
Daemon restart replays outstanding intents without extending old grants; unsafe overlapping attempts remain held.

tasks.title: Prove process ownership, expiry and restart recovery
tasks.scope: Implement discoverable process ownership across parent-only crashes, suspend-aware grant deadlines, stop escalation, reattachment checks and drain recovery.
acceptance: Inject crashes before/after spawn and restart with surviving descendants; uncertain writers keep reservations/workspaces protected.
Expiry/revocation stops execution; reattachment requires renewed authority; new execution uses a new attempt/session.
out_of_scope: Live reattachment, whole-container/PID-namespace recovery without durable stop evidence, external-service writers and hostile process/file manipulation.
Physical suspend/power-loss and real harness/source retention qualification remain later integration/target-host work.

tasks.title: Accept distributed recovery and cancellation
tasks.scope: Inject transport loss, cancellation races, daemon/worker restarts and expired authority against the real execution fixture.
acceptance: X1-X3 and X5-X9 pass with explicit uncertainty; no duplicate settlement or unsafe reuse.
Control requests retain capacity under synthetic transfer load; injected failures are repeatable without wall-clock sleep races.
out_of_scope: Qualification is the cooperative Linux guardian synthetic execution profile with runtime-process restart; guardian loss retains uncertainty.
Real graph/Git delivery, production harnesses, physical suspend/power loss and fleet capacity remain M4-M6 gates.

tasks.title: Publish scoped agent API contracts
tasks.scope: Define versioned graph context/search/mutation and operation-status schemas, capability scopes, provenance, expected versions, node recovery and CLI client contracts.
acceptance: Schema fixtures cover every batch/edge/context scope and pending/conflict/confirmed distinction.
No raw arbitrary graph proxy or worker graph credential is required; public contract supports independently generated clients.

tasks.title: Implement session credentials and scoped graph reads
tasks.scope: Provision protected per-attempt credentials, enforce current generation/expiry/revocation, and expose bounded authorized context/search/revision reads through the graph service.
acceptance: Search snippets, pagination, context expansion and relationship endpoints cannot leak out-of-scope data.
Cached context is revision-labelled; worker/node/graph service identities cannot be substituted for agent authority.

tasks.title: Implement durable graph mutation delivery and recovery
tasks.scope: Persist authorized immutable graph intent, expected versions and idempotency keys; reconcile uncertain outcomes, produce confirmed outbox events and expose bounded operation lookup.
acceptance: Commit-before-response-loss replays the identical intent without duplicate graph history; version conflict never becomes blind overwrite.
Cancelled/expired sessions cannot admit new writes; node recovery can inspect existing attempt operations without renewed agent mutation access.

tasks.title: Schedule real graph candidates with explicit eligibility
tasks.scope: Replace test-only task input with bounded graph-ready/context queries and central eligibility/priority/locality decisions; preserve independent local admission.
acceptance: Readiness alone never claims execution; admitted revisions are recorded and invalidating changes prevent stale settlement.
Multiple projects share capacity, cold eligible nodes can prepare work, and decisions/refusals expose reasons without full Git scans.

tasks.title: Provision the AQ agent client and bounded context cache
tasks.scope: Package the compatible AQ client, supply protected per-session credential bindings and labelled context snapshots, and handle expired/uncertain request responses.
acceptance: Fake AQ API tests run without the daemon or graph; session/node credential separation is preserved.
Offline proposed edits are never reported as applied; runtime can recover known or centrally listed attempt operations without renewing agent writes.

tasks.title: Integrate local aq-git workspaces and storage admission
tasks.scope: Consume the qualified binary through its public local API for base import, on-demand workspace, checkpoint, retention and safe cache eviction.
acceptance: All ambiguous calls reuse operation IDs; writers stop before checkpoint/retirement.
Alternating projects and disk pressure preserve active/pending data, bound caches and refuse new work when protected storage fills.

tasks.title: Implement authenticated source transfer and central retention
tasks.scope: Implement bounded attempt/repository-scoped artifact endpoints, staging, central aq-git import and retained receipts distinct from upload acknowledgements.
acceptance: Server maps trusted assignment metadata to allowed Git operations and rejects arbitrary worker paths/URLs/commands.
Stale attempts may retain authorized recovery source but cannot restore execution authority or settle newer work.

tasks.title: Implement resumable artifact handoff and retention release
tasks.scope: Add authenticated download/upload, offsets/digests, checkpoint receipts, result attachment and safe local retirement using separate transfer budgets.
acceptance: Restart mid-checkpoint/upload/report preserves IDs and required data; transport success is never central retention.
Central retention survives deletion of stopped worker storage; full pending-result storage blocks admission without blocking control.

tasks.title: Support one real harness with tested confinement
tasks.scope: Select and document one CLI harness/model configuration and implement configuration, process ownership, results, default workspace confinement and explicit folder grants.
acceptance: Real harness compatibility proves launch/stop/reattach capability and refusal of unsupported grant configurations.
Agent reads scoped context and edits only its configured writable roots in the supported cooperative model; credentials are not put in prompts/logs.

tasks.title: Apply evidence-based result disposition and graph completion
tasks.scope: Connect immutable worker reports and retained source to pinned outcome/evidence contracts and an authorized version-checked task completion operation.
acceptance: Success text/exit status alone cannot complete a task; stale revisions or cancelled-before-acceptance attempts cannot auto-settle.
Graph completion remains pending until confirmed; crash/replay emits one logical completion event.

tasks.title: Demonstrate a real agent with retained source and graph outcome
tasks.scope: Run one supported repository/task through actual agent context access, code change, source handoff, result policy and confirmed graph mutation.
acceptance: Delete stopped worker data after central retention and show the result remains usable; inject a lost graph response.
Observe explicit authorization/version checks and retain exact source/evidence identities without a worker graph database.

tasks.title: Implement durable supervisor and agent messaging
tasks.scope: Add scoped task/session mailboxes, durable delivery IDs/cursors and acknowledgement states separate from typed cancellation directives.
acceptance: Old-session messages cannot land in a reused slot; sender/recipient scopes are authenticated.
Replay distinguishes received, handed-to-harness, unknown and stale delivery; replies cannot impersonate another session.

tasks.title: Deliver messages through the real harness safely
tasks.scope: Persist mailbox receipt, integrate input at supported harness boundaries and report ambiguous injection without automatic duplicate delivery.
acceptance: Crash between injection and acknowledgement yields explicit uncertainty unless harness IDs prove deduplication.
Cancellation and renewals remain responsive during chat/log/transfer activity.

tasks.title: Host bounded supervisor sessions centrally
tasks.scope: Implement the first central supervisor/assessment execution adapter with resolved role configuration, isolated provider credentials and normal AQ message/API access.
acceptance: Supervisor communicates with remote sessions through durable messaging without entering a worker node.
Bounded session cancellation/results and credential separation are tested; no supervisor secret is provisioned to workers.
out_of_scope: General supervisor autonomy or all v1 profiles

tasks.title: Embed the qualified playbook runner with bounded execution
tasks.scope: Pin runner/compiler/storage libraries, bind host authority and outbox input, and isolate synchronous storage/host work from async control handlers.
acceptance: Exclusive ownership, startup/restart recovery, immutable artifacts and activation are integrated without reading AQ tables from the engine.
A blocked storage/host operation cannot stall lease renewal or cancellation; synthetic host commands are not registered as production adapters.

tasks.title: Implement core work, context and operation host adapters
tasks.scope: Register context.read, work.ensure, work.change, operation.get, operation.cancel and message.send against typed AQ services with durable request IDs and finite contracts.
acceptance: Work creation and completion have distinct dispositions; retries cannot create another task/attempt or widen authority.
Host contract fixtures exercise scoped context, owned cancellation, pending effects and exact revision conflicts.

tasks.title: Implement judgment, decision and check host adapters
tasks.scope: Implement judgment.request, decision.request and check.request with bounded central assessments, durable human decisions and actual check execution bound to exact subjects.
acceptance: A model assessment cannot impersonate human approval; stale decisions and checks do not authorize changed source.
Async acceptance, completion, cancellation and late outcomes remain distinct and replayable.

tasks.title: Implement candidate preparation and guarded publication policy
tasks.scope: Implement candidate.prepare and candidate.publish with central aq-git, exact retained inputs, required check/review evidence and current destination preconditions.
acceptance: Disposable-remote pilot repairs a conflict with a new candidate and new applicable evidence; publication never runs on workers.
Lost publication acknowledgement reconciles the same operation rather than pushing again; stale evidence blocks publication.
out_of_scope: Publishing user production branches during qualification

tasks.title: Implement findings reconciliation and durable calendar/report coordination
tasks.scope: Implement findings.reconcile, complete scoped observation inputs, finding episodes/notification outbox, and host-owned schedule occurrence cursors for watcher/report pilots.
acceptance: Partial scans cannot clear unseen findings; reminders and notification retries produce one logical message.
Report timeout/fallback and late author completion cannot double-send; timezone/misfire behavior is tested with frozen time.

tasks.title: Accept real policy-driven pilot workflows
tasks.scope: Run coding/review/check/repair, routing, watcher and report pilots against real AQ adapters and the pinned runner, with deterministic substitutes only for designated external model/provider calls.
acceptance: Exactly the agreed twelve production host commands are registered; fake-host passing tests are not substituted for adapter tests.
Crash between domain effect and runner receipt preserves child ownership, authority, deduplication and completion policy.

tasks.title: Establish the playbook storage and scheduling operating envelope
tasks.scope: Reconcile in-progress indexing/retention changes before assigning new work. Measure growing run/event/receipt history, pending children and concurrent admission; enforce tested namespace bounds and assess fairness/queue behavior against the intended AQ workload.
acceptance: Retain scaling data and exact configuration, including synchronous storage costs and quotas; no unresolved work is discarded.
Publish an admissible workload envelope and fail acceptance where required budgets are not met; add scoped optimization tasks to this graph before claiming broader scale.
out_of_scope: Treating the 100-admission microbenchmark as 500-agent product evidence
Silently widening limits after a failing benchmark

tasks.title: Expose task, attempt and workflow explanation views
tasks.scope: Publish bounded browser/client contracts for tasks, attempts, workers, messages, runs and permitted actions with freshness, revision, pending-operation and reason metadata.
acceptance: UI mocks derive from versioned schemas; authoritative state and last observations are distinct.
CLI and dashboard routes share domain operations and authorization; every pending/unknown result is representable.

tasks.title: Create the independent dashboard application and mock suite
tasks.scope: Initialize the component repository, select a frontend framework, and implement authenticated task/attempt and worker inspection against contract-derived mocks.
acceptance: Build/component/accessibility checks need no AQ daemon, graph or workers.
Large paginated views render stale/unknown/truncated states and untrusted content safely.

tasks.title: Implement pending-safe actions and browser compatibility
tasks.scope: Add one decision/cancellation/message flow through the public API, operation recovery, conflict-preserving drafts and stale-tab compatibility handling.
acceptance: Repeated clicks and lost responses do not duplicate actions or fabricate success; authorization failures are displayed accurately.
Session changes clear protected caches, revision conflicts preserve drafts and incompatible API prompts safe reload.

tasks.title: Version the composite product manifest and component inventory
tasks.scope: Extend the signed release format for exact deployable images, embedded library/binary/UI inventories, API/capability windows and per-owner persistent-state compatibility.
acceptance: Old updaters reject unsupported formats and have a documented upgrade path; version ranges do not replace exact artifact pins.
CI rejects missing/mismatched embedded inventories and local overrides; no second competing component lock authority is introduced.

tasks.title: Implement multi-component update and recovery orchestration
tasks.scope: Extend the existing updater with ordered admission/drain, per-owner migrations, readiness and resumable steps for the assembled stack.
acceptance: Interrupt each update boundary; restore/forward-repair decisions respect actual persistent-state compatibility.
Updates protect renewal/reporting or explicitly drain first; offline older supported workers reconcile after central upgrade.

tasks.title: Package and verify the dashboard in the server release
tasks.scope: Verify the static bundle digest/provenance/API metadata, embed it in the server image, and serve same-origin authenticated application assets.
acceptance: Exact bundle/server browser smoke covers authentication, inspection and one authorized action.
An existing tab detects changed API compatibility and refreshes matching assets without a stale success claim.

tasks.title: Run the complete product capacity and recovery profile
tasks.scope: Exercise 500 simulated agents across 50 logical workers for the declared duration, graph fixture, sustained/burst rates and network conditions, with real product adapters and measured background/UI traffic.
acceptance: Report latency, failed arrivals, pool/lock/queue waits, control safety margins, retry amplification and retained storage against shared design budgets.
Use restarts, contention, maintenance and reconnect storms; record any missed budget as a release blocker or explicitly narrower candidate scope, not a passing capacity claim.

tasks.title: Qualify the deployment target and component recovery profile
tasks.scope: On an explicitly selected disposable target, verify ingress/authentication, hosted credential paths, backup/restore, installed artifacts and the supported Git/repository/durability profile.
acceptance: Retain actual host/resource/network/artifact evidence and restore results; local source/test reports do not stand in for deployment proof.

Before any production readiness claim, resolve required component gates, qualify any protection facility used by workflows (otherwise refuse protected values), and document remaining unsupported capabilities.
out_of_scope: Changing live credentials or user repositories without deployment-task authorization

tasks.title: Accept a usable, measured and upgradeable AQ product candidate
tasks.scope: Evaluate exact-artifact evidence for the selected capability/profile envelope and record the candidate release decision and unresolved exclusions.
acceptance: All required gates and supported-version checks pass, including browser action, retained source, task policy, upgrade and recovery.
Manifest, runbooks and measured capacity agree with actual artifacts; production publication/deployment is a separate explicitly scheduled action.
